attributes.action: Investigate possible student loan mis-selling after debt rose despite payments
attributes.additional_details: Plan 1 repayments depend on income, but interest is added to the debt separately. If the interest is more than a borrower repays, the debt grows even when they make every required payment. I borrowed £22,173 in 2006; by April 2017, I owed more than I had borrowed. I did not understand this could happen. The Government should investigate what borrowers were told, acknowledge any failure to explain this clearly and provide redress where appropriate.
attributes.background: Require an independent investigation into whether Plan 1 borrowers were adequately informed that their balances could grow despite required repayments. Publish the findings, acknowledge any communication failures and provide redress where appropriate.

rejection.details:
We think this petition is very similar to yours: 

Review & compensate graduates whose student debt is higher than amount borrowed: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/780421
